name: Shufti | Identity Verification Service
author: Shufti

sections.description:
Shufti is a real-time identity verification and AML screening platform built for businesses that need to know exactly who they’re dealing with. The Shufti plugin connects your WordPress site directly to Shufti’s verification engine, so visitors can complete ID document checks, biometric face verification, and AML watchlist screening without ever leaving your site.

To use the plugin for live verification, you’ll need an active Shufti account. If you’d like to test the flow first, request a demo and use the trial key to get started. When you’re ready to go live, our integration team will help configure Shufti to fit your verification workflow.

What This Plugin Does

  • Identity Verification (KYC): Verify users in real time with ID document checks, biometric face matching, and liveness detection.
  • AML Screening: Screen users instantly against global sanctions, PEP, and watchlists.
  • Shortcode-Based Embed: Drop a single shortcode anywhere on your site to launch the verification flow. No custom development required.
  • Flexible Activation: Connect a live Shufti account, or start with a free trial key to test the flow before going live.
  • Detailed Back-Office Reporting: Every verification result, including image and video proof, is logged in Shufti’s back-office dashboard for compliance audit trails.

Top Features

  • Verifies users in real time without them leaving your website.
  • Multiple automated ID verification checks to choose from.
  • GDPR and PCI-compliant, with proper data protection protocols throughout.
  • Broad global coverage of ID document types and languages.
  • Instant AML screening against global sanctions, PEP and watchlists.
  • AI-assisted verification models for fast, consistent decisioning.
  • Hybrid verification model combining AI with human review.

Additional Features

  • Responsive design with a simple, frictionless UI/UX.
  • Integrated workflows for a convenient end-to-end user journey.
  • Customised verification flows tailored to your business needs.
  • Detailed verification reports, including image and video proof of each check.
  • Regular updates and new features.

How It Works

  1. Install the Shufti plugin and activate it on your WordPress site.
  2. Activate your subscription, or start in trial mode.
  3. Enter your Client ID and Secret Key to connect your account.
  4. Select the verification parameters you want applied to your users.
  5. Save your settings to generate a shortcode.
  6. Paste the shortcode onto any page or post to enable verification.
  7. Users complete verification without leaving your website.
  8. Shufti verifies the user in real time and stores the result in compliance with data protection regulations.
  9. Results are stored in the Shufti back-office, with image and video proof attached to each verification.

Languages

The plugin interface is available in English. End-user verification supports multiple languages.

Support

Questions or feedback can be sent to tech@shuftipro.com, or raised directly in the support forum.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload shuftipro-kyc.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Enter your Client id and Secret Key.
  4. Select general parameters.
  5. Place provided shortcode in anywhere on your site.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Shufti account to use this plugin?

Yes. You’ll need a Shufti account with a Client ID and Secret Key, which you can get by starting a free trial or activating a subscription.

How do I add identity verification to a page?

After connecting your account, copy the shortcode generated in your plugin settings and paste it onto any page or post. It renders a verification flow your visitors can complete without leaving the site.

Can I try it before subscribing?

Yes. Request a trial key from Shufti and use it to test the full verification flow before committing to a subscription.

What ID documents and countries are supported?

Shufti supports a broad range of government-issued ID documents across multiple countries and languages.

Where can I see my verification results?

Every verification, including image and video proof, is logged in your Shufti back-office dashboard, so you have a full audit trail for compliance reporting.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. Shufti is GDPR and PCI-compliant, and verification data is handled under proper data protection protocols.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial Release.

1.1.3

  • Update Assets and style.

1.1.4

  • Update Plugin to fix warning for end user

1.1.5

  • Update Plugin to fix KYC verification issue in new window

1.1.6

  • Update Plugin from Basic KYC verification to Detailed KYC

1.1.7

  • Rebranded plugin to Shufti.
  • Updated plugin description.
  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.

1.1.8

  • Security: settings and API credentials can now only be changed by an administrator, through the WordPress admin, with nonce verification.
  • Removed the directly-accessible settings scripts.
  • Credentials and settings are now stored in WordPress options (using the site table prefix) instead of hardcoded custom tables, and are preserved across updates.
  • After updating, please open the Shufti KYC settings once and click “Go Live” to re-activate the verification button.
